text: Does your calendar look like a solid wall of back-to-back meetings? It’s easy to feel burnt out when there’s zero gap between tasks. A simple beginner habit to fix this is scheduling "buffer zones." Block out just 15 minutes before and after every major call. This gives you time to actually process notes, grab water, or just breathe. It transforms your schedule from a stressful list of demands into a manageable flow. Start small today and reclaim your focus.
